articles.title: Filipino engineer wins £30,000 award for sensor that detects hidden earthquake damage in buildings
articles.summary: A Filipino structural engineer has won the 2026 James Dyson Global Sustainability Award and £30,000 for developing Sentinel, a sensor that detects hidden damage in buildings after earthquakes. Developed by Aldrei Ong, the technology uses self-sensing concrete to identify cracks and monitor structural changes.

articles.title: UP Assistant Teacher recruitment 2026: UPESSC relaxes graduation marks criteria for eligible candidates; check official notice
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has revised eligibility criteria for the Assistant Teacher recruitment. Certain candidates who entered teacher education programmes before July 29, 2011, will no longer need to meet minimum graduation marks.

articles.title: ICAI CA Foundation September 2026 result to be declared tomorrow at caresults.icai.org: Check complete details here
articles.summary: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) will announce the CA Foundation September 2026 result on November 6. Candidates will be able to access their scorecards using their registration and roll numbers on the official result portal.
